features: Dual Connector OTG Pen Drive – Equipped with Type-C & USB-A connectors, enabling seamless data transfer between smartphones, tablets, laptops, PCs, MacBooks, Gaming Consoles & Camera without the need for adapters.

Premium Full Metal Body – Durable metal casing offers superior protection against everyday wear, heat, and minor shocks while delivering a sleek, premium look.

Wide Device Compatibility – Compatible with smartphones (OTG supported), Windows PCs, laptops, tablets, Mac OS devices, Gaming Console, Camera; supports plug-and-play functionality with no additional software required.
Compact & Travel-Friendly Design – Lightweight, pocket-sized design with secure connectors makes it perfect for work, travel, office use, and daily data storage on the go.
